query: Run /council on this completed market-entry analysis. Challenge its assumptions and tell me whether to proceed.
expected_behavior: The agent treats the supplied analysis as the artifact under review rather than replacing it with a new plan
It selects relevant specialist mandates, collects blind opening positions, runs one rebuttal round, tests relevant scenarios, and produces a reconciled recommendation
It identifies assumptions, evidence gaps, the strongest objection, confidence, reversal conditions, and a concrete next action
It does not implement the recommendation
